sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, phone number, email address, and booking details. We also collect usage data to improve our services.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
• To process pooja and room bookings
• To send booking confirmations and reminders via WhatsApp/SMS
• To contact you regarding your bookings
• To improve our app and services

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Your information is shared only with service providers necessary to complete your booking (e.g., payment gateways).

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at pooja@trimbakeshwarpoojavidhi.in.
